basic_info.description: Prime mixed-use property on iconic Mission Street, San Francisco! This gem features an updated and vacant 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit upstairs, complete with washer & dryer hook-ups, ready for the next occupants.   The commercial space, currently utilized by a community resource group, offers over 1,000 sq ft, access to a large yard, and a versatile basement area currently functioning as a bike shop. Ideal for investors or business owners looking to establish a presence in a vibrant neighborhood. Don't miss out on this opportunity!
